commit_message:
[Merged] [json] Stringfy: Front-load some checks for fast-path

We need to check that we don't have interesting properties (toJSON)
anywhere on JSObject and JSArray prototype chains.
Previously this was ensured whenever we serialize a JSObject/JSArray,
but we can front-load all the checks on the prototypes to the start of
serialization and only check that the prototype is the expected one for
each object.

Bug: 380044242

fix_commit_message:
[json] Stringify: Check for context-less meta maps

Before retrieving the native context from an object, ensure that we are
not dealing with context-less meta-maps (e.g. detached globals).

Fixed: 396460426

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix a2e2bfb70955 on top of intro c535aa4fecbf via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: A refactor (commit c535aa4) moved the native-context lookup to the beginning of `SerializeObject` to front-load prototype checks for the fast path. The refactored code assumed every JSObject/JSArray would have a meta-map with a native context, which is false for detached globals whose meta-map is the read-only `meta_map` root. No guard was added to handle this case before invoking `native_context()`.
